contract:
Contract LibraryManagementSystemSystem::payOverDueFee(uid: String,fee: Real): Boolean {
	precondition:
		User.allInstances()->one(u: User|u.UserID = uid and
		u.OverDueFee>0.0 and
		fee>=u.OverDueFee and
		u.LoanedBook->exists(l: Loan|l.IsReturned = true and
		l.OverDueFee>0.0 and
		l.DueDate.isBefore(l.ReturnDate)))
	postcondition:
		result = true and
		User.allInstances()->forAll(u: User|if u.UserID@pre = uid 
		then u.OverDueFee = 0.0 
		else true 
		endif ) and
		Loan.allInstances()->forAll(l: Loan|if l.LoanedUser.UserID@pre = uid and
		l.IsReturned@pre = true and
		l.OverDueFee@pre>0.0 and
		l.DueDate@pre.isBefore(l.ReturnDate@pre) 
		then l.OverDueFee = 0.0 
		else true 
		endif )
}
